Privacy Policy

FieldCalc collects nothing. There is no server to send anything to.

Last updated: 14 October 2026

The short version: this app has no accounts, no backend, no analytics, no advertising, and no third-party services. Every value you type is calculated on your own device and stays there.

Information we collect

None. FieldCalc does not collect, transmit, store on our systems, sell, or share any personal information. We do not ask for your name, email address, phone number, or location, and the app has no way to send data anywhere.

Information stored on your device

When you complete a calculation, the app saves a short summary of it — the values you entered and the result — using your browser or device's local storage. This exists only so the Field log survives closing the app.

  • It never leaves your device.
  • It is not readable by us or by anyone else.
  • A maximum of 100 entries is kept; older ones and their photos are discarded automatically.
  • You can erase all of it at any time with Clear all in the field log.
  • Uninstalling the app, or clearing your browser's site data, also erases it.

Photos and camera

If you choose to attach a photo to a saved calculation, FieldCalc asks for camera or photo library access, and only uses it when you tap Photo. The picture is reduced in size and stored in the app's private storage on your device, next to the calculation it belongs to.

  • Photos are never uploaded, synced, or shared by the app.
  • Sharing a result sends only its text, and only to the app you pick in your device's share sheet.
  • Deleting an entry from the field log deletes its photo; Clear all deletes every photo.
  • You can revoke camera or photo access at any time in your device's settings.

Analytics, tracking, and cookies

There are none. The app sets no cookies, contains no tracking pixels, no advertising identifiers, and no analytics or crash-reporting SDKs. No profile of you is built, because no information about you is ever received.

Network connections

After the first load the app works fully offline. The web version downloads its own files from its hosting provider on first visit — a normal web request that provider logs like any other, including your IP address — and installed versions from the App Store or Google Play do not make that request at all, since the files ship inside the app. No calculation data is ever part of any request.

Children's privacy

The app is a general-purpose utility and is safe for all ages. Because it collects no information from anyone, it collects none from children.

Changes to this policy

If a future version adds optional accounts or cloud sync, this policy will be updated before that feature ships, and any such feature will be opt-in. The date above shows when this policy last changed.

Contact

Questions about this policy can be raised at the project's issue tracker.

FieldCalc is a convenience tool. Verify design and code calculations independently. It makes no claim of code compliance, engineering approval, or design suitability.
